set.summary: How a person signs in with email and password.

node.label: Login form
node.description: Collects email and password and posts them to the API.
node.plain: The page where you type your email and password.

node.label: POST /api/login
node.description: Checks credentials and creates a session cookie.
node.plain: The server checks your details and remembers you.

node.label: User table
node.description: Looks up the user by email.

node.label: Session store
node.description: Stores session rows that back the session cookie.

steps.text: The person types their email and password.
The API looks up the user and checks the password.
A session is stored and a cookie is set.
